body.p: A wolverine was about to cross the river. It can't cross in any way. Then it started to cry. When it had started to cry, a fox came from downstream. The fox asked the wolverine: "Why are you crying?" "I wanted to cross the river, but I can't in any way". The fox said: "Well, I'll take you to the other side". The wolverine loaded its shammies for bringing them to the other side first. The fox said: "Afterwards, I'll bring you". The fox went off. Then it ran downstream. When the fox had went off, the wolverine started to cry. When it was crying, a woodpecker came flying. It asked: "Why are you crying?" That one [= the wolverine] said: "My things were taken away by the fox". The woodpecker followed the fox downstream. Having caught up the fox, the woodpecker said: "Well, seat me in your boat!" "I can't seat [you]". Then the woodpecker said: "I'll sit down on something". The fox said: "Well, man, sat down. Somehow we arrive". The woodpecker said: "Cover me with something". They went off. The woodpecker said: "Man, why does our boat get wet, let's land at the shore". When they had landed, the fox said to its friend: "Let me go for resin in order to caulk our boat". The fox went off. When its friend had gone off, the woodpecker stopped up the hole in the boat. Having stopped it up, the woodpecker went upstream to the wolverine. When the woodpecker came, the wolverine was very happy. The woodpecker said: "Well, man, I brought your belongings". The fox came to the landing place. [There is] nothing at all.
